finding: RC4-07; the fourth recheck of the F2 contracts layer
case: `under_negation` struck from the pinned census key set, leaving the literal in validate_contracts.py untouched.
why: RC4-07 is that `CENSUS_KEYS` was declared exactly once, in the file that also decides whether the census carries those keys. Dropping a field from the literal and from the check is one hunk, after which the verdict prints a census that LOOKS complete. This fixture narrows ONE side; the whole value of a second declaration is that doing so is now visible.
